segments.en: Hello.
Tell me, who are you talking to?
I am not talking to anyone.
Oh, okay. What is your name?
Karthik, what is your name?
My name is Rani. What do you do for work?
I work as a team head in a company.
What about you?
I am working in a real estate company.
Is that so? Are you single?
I am married and have a son. What about you?
I am single. I am 26 years old.
I am 36.
Okay, okay. You are 10 years older than me.
Okay, okay.
Tell me.
Tell me, why did you come to this app?
I didn't understand.
Why did you come to this app?
I just came here. Why are you asking me for the second time?
Oh, okay, okay.
My mind was upset, so I came here. Why, what happened?
I asked you why you came here. Everyone has a purpose. I came here for a good friend. Everyone has a purpose, so I wanted to know.
How is the app?
I don't know, I don't come here often.
Is that so? Okay, okay.
What happened? Is your mind not okay?
It's nothing, my mind was just upset. I thought I would talk to someone, maybe a stranger, it would be better.
Oh, is that so? Okay, okay.
What about you?
I told you, I came here for a friend.
How is everyone at home?
Everyone is fine. Is everyone fine at your home?
Yes, they are fine.
What does your husband do?
My husband is busy with his work.
What are you talking about?
We don't talk much. Why?
Some people are married but live separately. We are married but live separately.
Why, what happened?
We have some money problems and understanding problems, so we live separately.
Why don't you stay together in the same house?
Are you angry with him?
Why would I be angry? If we talk, we fight. If we don't talk, we don't fight.
We are busy with our work. I work in a real estate company.
Okay, okay. Okay, okay.
If you stay alone at home, you will be more depressed.
What do your children do?
He is in 11th grade.
He is in 11th grade.
Okay, okay.
Tell me.
You tell me.
What did you eat?
Where are you?
I am in a Chennai-based company in Coimbatore.
Okay, okay.
Is it HR?
No, it's not HR. It's a team head role. Companies give us projects, and we manage them.
Oh, okay, okay. You have to manage the people under you.
Yes, there are 26-30 people under me. I have to plan how to do the work.
Is it a software line or another line? Financial?
It's a software line.
Software?
Yes, like Zoho software.
Oh, okay, okay.
The team is mostly a team head, and some are in the financial level, like the bank line. I have worked there before, so I asked.
You are talking about tele-calling, right?
No, there is tele-calling, and there is a team head. There are team leaders and team managers. There are many posts.
Yes, there is tele-calling, collection, and all that.
This is what we do. We go directly to the customer and see how to use our software efficiently.
Okay, okay, okay, okay.
Tell me.
You tell me, you have to tell me.
Are you in sales?
Sales?
Yes, I am a friend of another sir. We both together sell projects of other companies on a commission basis.
Okay, okay.
How is it? Do you get 10% or 20%?
It depends on the company. In Madurai, they give a maximum of 2%.
Maximum, they give 2%. We also take 2% from the customer side.
The owner gives a company project based on the location. If it's a bit far or expensive, they give 7%, 5%, or 3%.
So if it's high, it's 2%, and if it's low, it increases?
If the land is 8-9 lakhs per cent, it's hard to sell.
No one buys a cent for 8 lakhs. They buy a flat for 8 lakhs, 2-3 cents. So when we do that, we get 7%.
It's rare to close. If we close other places, we get 2%.
Customer side, we take 2%.
Okay, okay.
There is some land in Kanchipuram, but I don't know how it is. I have been thinking about it for a long time.
There is one ground.
In Kanchipuram?
Yes.
It's in Coimbatore, right?
Yes, but the land is in Kanchipuram.
How much is the rate?
I don't know, they are asking for 5 lakhs.
5 lakhs?
Yes.
How many cents is it?
I don't know the cents. It's 1600 square feet, I think.
I know a friend in Coimbatore who is in real estate, so I asked.
Okay.
I asked if I could tell them, that's all.
Two people are looking after that in the real estate company.
They are saying they will sell it, some say they don't want to sell it. They say they will sell it when they get married.
If they want to sell it with one mind, we can tell someone to process it.
Yes, that's what I said.
Because I only get leads for Madurai, so I only do Madurai.
My friends are in Chennai, and they do real estate there. So if anyone asks for Chennai, I will tell them.
If anyone asks for Coimbatore, I will tell them here, that's all.
They have some clients, so if we tell them and they are okay, they will finish it.
If we get some income, it's okay.
Okay, okay.
What did you eat?
I ate sambar chicken.
Sambar chicken? In Neyyattinkara?
Yes.
Is it different?
I have heard of Madurai sambar chicken, but sambar chicken in Neyyattinkara is okay.
I always eat rice at night.
Are you at home or in a hostel?
I am at home.
In Neyyattinkara, lunch is good. At night, chicken...
We rarely go to hotels. Maybe once a year, we go to a hotel.
No, that's okay. It's okay. Because most people eat sambar chicken for lunch. Some people eat rasam and chicken at night.
We also eat like that.
Okay, okay, good habit. Good boy.
Are you married?
No, I am telling you. Usually, everyone expects this and that. If you say you will eat anything, you are a good boy. It's a good sign for your future wife.
I will cook it myself.
That's what I said, you are a good boy. I asked you, and you said you will learn.
I am learning to cook.
You have to learn.
I used to do non-veg before. I can do it well. I have been teaching myself for a long time.
Because the future wife shouldn't scold us.
Yes, I am full-time... I will tell her that I will cook, so don't scold me.
That's what I said, the future wife shouldn't ask what kind of child you have raised.
Yes.
